# QnALog 1.6.9

## Highlights

- Short recordings are now judged by content instead of length. Recordings under 1 second are discarded without transcription. Recordings from 1 to under 10 seconds are transcribed once: a blank result discards the audio and note; a complete sentence or a to-do creates a note; shorter text keeps the audio, creates no note and shows the recognized text in a notice. If the transcription result is far longer than the recording could contain, the audio is kept and no note is created. If transcription fails, the audio and a retry task are kept. Imported audio is not affected, and turning short-recording filtering off keeps the old normal flow.
- Deleting a note that has derived versions now asks what to do: keep the latest derived version as the note (the other derived versions point to it), or delete the note with all derived versions. Notes without derived versions are deleted as before.
- Retrying a failed merge no longer overwrites edits you made to the note while the model was running. The generated result is not written, and the task stays retryable with an explanation.
- If API keys cannot be written to Obsidian SecretStorage, the background queue is still saved. Your existing settings file is left unchanged.
- Choosing a service preset in the AI organizing page no longer reuses the previous service's key or changes the saved API profile; "Custom service…" keeps the current key. The setup wizard prefills the saved key when the current service matches the one you pick.

## User impact

The settings schema is unchanged and no notes are rewritten. After selecting a service preset you need to enter that service's key (SiliconFlow still reuses its saved transcription key). Short recordings between 1 and 10 seconds now call your transcription service once, which can use a small amount of quota. No settings need to be reconfigured.
